title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
abstract: arXiv:2611.29663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights. translated_title: 纸面精确：以重排相同请求产生的噪声为基准，衡量哪些LLM服务捷径会翻转评分答案
translated_abstract: 团队通常在确认基准测试准确率不变后，才启用前缀缓存、分块预填充和投机解码等推理服务功能，因为引擎文档将这些功能标注为“精确”。但准确率是一个聚合指标，因此某项功能可以在保持总体准确率的同时，改变哪些请求被正确回答。我们在 vLLM 中部署一个 4B 指令模型，在九种单一功能配置和五份参考配置副本下运行，每次运行对来自五个基准测试的 3,380 个请求进行评分，并将每种候选配置与重启底线（全新进程）和调度底线（相同请求以不同顺序运行）进行比较。在默认内核下，所有配置的准确率偏差均不超过 1 个百分点；七种“精确”功能翻转了 1.47%（95% CI：1.13–1.85）至 1.78%（1.39–2.20）请求的评分结果，均未超过 1.72% 的调度底线；而 FP8 KV 缓存翻转了 3.36%（2.80–3.96）的请求，与 FP8 权重的翻转率相当。在使用批量不变内核的情况下……
tldr: 该论文创新性地提出以“重启底线”和“调度底线”（重排相同请求）作为噪声基准来评估LLM服务端的“精确”优化功能，发现七种精确功能虽保持总体准确率不变，但会翻转1.47%–1.78%请求的评分结果（未超过1.72%的调度噪声底线），而FP8 KV缓存的翻转率（3.36%）则与FP8权重的破坏性相当。
en_tdlr: By introducing restart and scheduling noise floors as baselines, this paper shows that seven "exact" vLLM serving features keep aggregate accuracy unchanged while flipping 1.47%–1.78% of graded answers (within the 1.72% scheduling noise floor), whereas the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36%—as many as FP8 weights.
